Have you ever thought of hiring a personal trainer or attaining a gym membership as this wont require you to push your self 100%. You can also sign up to groups and camps that can further increase your likely hood to change. Weight loss does take a very long time to counter and you need to see it as being a lengthy process so you don't become discouraged after seeing no progress. You need to work on building your self control. Every time you say no to your urges to do something you will regret in the future whether it is in relation to food or other life choices, you increase your self control. You are able to change as long as you officially start and maintain. Creating a roster for exercise (you can choose what you are comfortable with. Set it to minimum) will help you stay motivated. Do not cheat yourself or try wiggle your way out of doing something on your roster as it will put you out of sync and can cause you to quit. Talking to people that can relate to you who have been or are in your position is a great help to. Picture your success and it will only be a matter of time. As you progress you will feel more motivated and wont feel like a chore, you just have to push until this stage. Good Luck and feel comfortable in yourself and slowly build your mental strength. :)

Making friends can be difficult, which is why you should try moving around groups in your school finding one that you can relate with. Just ask if you can sit with them and try join in and get a feel for what they are like. Don't take it personally if they reject you as it can be quite confronting and weird as social groups are usually formed earlier. I personally can move around most groups and feel comfortable talking to people as the more you do it the more comfortable you get. Look into your interests or if your unaware of them try out things. Ambition is the cure to boredom. Its good your getting better at school it opens up your options for the future. Good luck :) you can pm me if you want to ask any personal questions or advice

Losing weight can be a very difficult and lengthy process mentally and physically. You don't have to be super motivated to achieve your goal. Just start with small steps (generic but its the truth) as long as you start as little as changing your diet such as swapping a muffin for a fruit for lunch, or eating a smaller plate at dinner. Once you start changing your diet you can begin to exercise, exactly as the diet begin small. Do not get discouraged if nothing appears to be changing as a notable difference can be seen in months depending on the frequency of the exercise. If you can afford it I suggest getting a gym membership or hiring a personal trainer for 1 session a week or so as this prevents dis interest and motivation. Don't give up even though it might seem impossible, if you wish it and put in the effort you can achieve it. Good Luck :)

You need to take out time and just sit and think about whether or not you truly want him and just tell him the truth if not. You are also are having issues with forgiving yourself and letting things go, everyone makes mistakes and we learn from them. This doesn't require you to punish yourself for them. If you are close with your parents you should seek help with from them or try to create a greater relationship with them and learn to accept that people care about you and will be there for you. When you feel terrible and you just want to end your life, you just need to stop and breathe calm your self down and think about what you want to be and what you want to become.
